cli.updateDone: The update is complete, version: v{{version}}, please run again.
cli.requiredUrl: The option url must be provided.
cli.option_url: Remote address or local file path (JSON or YAML).
cli.option_out: The output directory, the default is {{out}} under the current execution directory of stc.
cli.option_client: http request client. When `lang` is `ts/js`, the possible values ​​are: `axios`, `wechat`, `fetch`.
cli.option_lang: Language, the suffix used for the output file, [default: "ts"].
cli.option_filter: Filter interfaces, and the interfaces that meet the filter conditions will be generated.
cli.option_tag: Specify tags from the interface url for filenames, the first one of tags is read by default.
cli.option_shared: Whether to generate the shared directory. [default: true].
cli.option_clean: Whether to clean the output directory before generating. [default: true].
cli.option_globalHeader: Global header key configuration, multiple can be set. When a single API has the same key, it will not appear as a parameter.
cli.option_noDeprecated: Whether to ignore deprecated APIs. [default: false].
cli.option_config: Config file path. By default, looks for stc.config.json, stc.config.ts, stc.config.js, .stcrc.json, .stcrc in the current directory.
cli.option_watch: Watch the API document (local file or remote url) and regenerate on change. [default: false].
cli.option_interval: Polling interval in milliseconds when watching a remote url. [default: 3000].
